description: Import design tokens (W3C design-tokens JSON, Tokens Studio JSON, or CSS custom properties) as a versioned design system: the whole token graph is kept with its aliases, semantic roles and scales intact, and a Style is projected from it so decks can be generated in that system. Optionally name the heading/body faces and attach a logo. `path`/`logoPath` only work with the local `lorem-mcp` server — over a remote MCP connection, omit them and pass headingFont/bodyFont, or upload the file in the app (Library → Import) / with POST /api/import first.

bodyFont.description: Body family — wins over anything in the tokens

headingFont.description: Heading family — wins over anything in the tokens

logoPath.description: Absolute path to a logo image to attach to the system

path.description: Absolute path to the tokens .json / .css file

name: import_design_system
title: Import a design system
